description: This album has been a slow grower on me this year. First only the amazing(!) title track caught my... ear... But now, after many a listen, I relly enjoy the whole album. Greatful Dead-ish. In a good way.

Nearing halfway through the year, so it's time to highlight some favourite discoveries. This is the 2020 album I have listened the most to, methinks. Ole Paus with Motorpsycho as a backing band. Amazing.
Ole Paus is by some considered a kind of Norwegian Bob Dylan, and, fittingly the 79 years old(!) Dylan also relased an amazing album this year!
...and we're back in the nineties again. Tindersticks this time.

album: American IV: The Man Comes Around
description: Another rusty voice today. The late great Johnny Cash's 4th album of modern cover songs is my favorite. Best track: Hurt

Nearing the 100th album of this list -- presented in absolutely no particular order -- so it's time for some Bowie. This was actually the first album of him I really _listened_ to. Best song: I'm afraid of Americans. (The version with NIN (from yesterday's AOTD) on this extended version of the album is fantastic!)
And, then, the 100th album here! My favourite Bowie album in this world. Best song: Kooks
I guess Autechre in some ways are the exact opposite of Bowie's... organic seventies... But, still, great! And fitting for album 101. (Or, should I say: 0b1100101)
Best song is the the title track. (It seems that Johnny Cash thought so too...)
Swedish Wintergatan plays music that could be video game soundtracks -- whilst also sounding like Yann Tiersen. Very listenable.
As much as I love their debut album Moon Safari, I like this one even more. Great stuff. Also, Beck!
Another amazing album full of cover songs today. Bossa Nova style. Favourite track: The Dead Kennedy's cover...
Best track: I wanna be your dog
Best track: I Wanna Be Your Dog
First solo album of another of my all time favorite artists. Less known than Transformer or Berlin, but I love the velvet undergroundy feel to this one.
